definitions.explanation: A sequence of events or things happening one after another without interruption.

examples.japanese: {三日|みっか}{連続|れんぞく}で{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}った。
examples.english: It rained for three consecutive days.

examples.japanese: この{番組|ばんぐみ}は{連続|れんぞく}ドラマです。
examples.english: This program is a serial drama.
examples.notes: 連続ドラマ = TV series, serial drama

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{十年|じゅうねん}{連続|れんぞく}で{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
examples.english: He won the championship for ten consecutive years.

notes:
USAGE: {連続|れんぞく} emphasizes the unbroken sequence of events or things happening in succession.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜{連続|れんぞく}で (for ~ in a row, ~ consecutive)
・{連続|れんぞく}する (to continue, to occur consecutively)
・{連続|れんぞく}ドラマ (TV series, serial drama)
・{連続|れんぞく}{殺人|さつじん} (serial killings)

CONTRAST:
・{連続|れんぞく} - emphasizes consecutive occurrence
・{継続|けいぞく} - emphasizes ongoing continuation of an action
